title: Review
text: Review. Overall I will give 2 out of 5 points. The smells of pads is sooooooo bad, very stinky, so I didn’t put in on the desk. The cup holder is sticky and looks easy to break. The headphone holder is too inside, if move it outer will be great. I have no idea how to use that cable management since there are 2 cable holds.
